evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, the lockfile guard still computes `comparison="$(git -C trust merge-base refs/cq-transfer/base "$SUBJECT")"` unconditionally under `set -euo pipefail` before testing `KIND = pr`. If the base ref and subject have no merge base, the command substitution exits nonzero and the step aborts, so non-PR runs can fail before the PR-only lockfile check is reached. The finding’s line reference is stale, but the defect remains at current lines 268-269.
